scenes.title_cn: 开场：单主给我加薪啦！因为月初给单主…
scenes.title_en: Opening: My client gave me a raise! A vide…
scenes.context: 记录一条800元口播剪辑的全过程。
sentences: 单主给我加薪啦，因为月初给单主剪的那条视频爆了。
My client gave me a raise, because the video I cut earlier this month blew up.
Success brings more work.
这一条开箱口播800元子，看看我需要剪多久吧。
This unboxing talking-head ad is 800 yuan—let's see how long it takes to cut.
The 800-yuan job.
scenes.speak: My client gave me a raise, because the video I cut earlier this month blew up. This unboxing talking-head ad is 800 yuan—let's see how long it takes to cut.

scenes.title_cn: 准备：品牌方给的物料内容很多，都是补…
scenes.title_en: Preparation: the brand sent lots of supple…
scenes.context: 理解需求、整理素材是剪辑的前置工作。
sentences: 这次的品牌方给的物料内容还蛮多的，基本都是补充信息，越要契合单主的风格。
The brand sent quite a lot of materials, mostly supplementary info that must match the client's style.
Study the brand materials.
我还得去了解每个口红的色号编号，以及哪个是重点。
I also need to learn every lipstick's shade number and which one is the highlight.
Know the products.
素材总共40G，单主分为了三段，一段是上嘴，一段是手臂试色，还有一段是全景。
The footage totals 40G in three parts: lip swatches, arm swatches, and wide shots.
Organize the footage.
其实也就是一段A roll两段B roll，每个色号都要穿插来。
Basically one A-roll and two B-rolls, weaving each shade in.
Interleave A and B rolls.
scenes.speak: The brand sent quite a lot of materials, mostly supplementary info that must match the client's style. I also need to learn every lipstick's shade number and which one is the highlight. The footage totals 40G in three parts: lip swatches, arm swatches, and wide shots. Basically one A-roll and two B-rolls, weaving each shade in.

scenes.title_cn: 感慨：剪这种活得亏我是个小女孩，直男…
scenes.title_en: Reflection: this kind of job, lucky I'm a …
scenes.context: 对职业成长的回望与感慨。
sentences: 感觉这种活如果是一个直男来剪，估计看都要看迷糊。
I feel a guy would be completely lost trying to edit this.
Context and taste matter.
我上初高中的时候，大多数这种美妆视频都是这样全系列长视频，当时觉得哇塞好华丽。
In high school, most beauty videos were these long full-series ones—I thought they were gorgeous.
The childhood dream.
我以后也要有自己的全系列彩妆，这种视频现在是我在剪了。
I wanted my own full makeup line someday—and now I'm the one cutting these videos.
Dreams come around.
scenes.speak: I feel a guy would be completely lost trying to edit this. In high school, most beauty videos were these long full-series ones—I thought they were gorgeous. I wanted my own full makeup line someday—and now I'm the one cutting these videos.

scenes.title_cn: 初剪：下午4点粗剪完成，把40多分钟…
scenes.title_en: First cut: the rough cut is done at 4 PM—4…
scenes.context: 粗剪交审，反馈后进入修改。
sentences: 现在已经4点了，粗剪完成，把40多分钟的素材剪到了8分钟多一点。
It's 4 PM now—the rough cut is done, trimming 40+ minutes to just over 8.
40 minutes to 8.
先发给单主和PR，让他们审核一下看整体的素材节奏。
Send it to the client and PR to review the overall pacing.
Get review first.
反馈意见下来了，主要就是说现在的主推色和其他色没分开。
Feedback arrived—mainly that the hero shade isn't separated from the others.
Hero shade needs separation.
scenes.speak: It's 4 PM now—the rough cut is done, trimming 40+ minutes to just over 8. Send it to the client and PR to review the overall pacing. Feedback arrived—mainly that the hero shade isn't separated from the others.

scenes.title_cn: 修改：让主推时间加长，其他色分成4屏…
scenes.title_en: Revising: extend the hero shade's screen t…
scenes.context: 按明确意见修改，效率更高。
sentences: 让主推时间加长，其他色分成4屏展示就可以了。
Extend the hero shade and show the rest in a 4-panel display.
Hero longer, rest in panels.
现在已经6点20了，更改过的版本我已经发过去了。
It's 6:20 now, and I've sent over the revised version.
Rapid turnaround.
这个品牌方其实蛮专业的，直接明确指出了要什么不要什么，所以修改其实不是坏事。
This brand is quite professional—they said exactly what they want, so revisions aren't a bad thing.
Clear briefs beat guesswork.
scenes.speak: Extend the hero shade and show the rest in a 4-panel display. It's 6:20 now, and I've sent over the revised version. This brand is quite professional—they said exactly what they want, so revisions aren't a bad thing.

scenes.title_cn: 精剪：PR没问题直接开始精剪。为规避…
scenes.title_en: Fine cut: PR approved, so straight into th…
scenes.context: 精剪+包装完成首轮交付。
sentences: 为了规避版权，我所有的字体都使用的可商用的。
To avoid copyright trouble, all fonts I use are commercially licensed.
Commercial-safe fonts.
现在是7点50，我已经包装完了，整体时长现在是7分钟。
It's 7:50, I've finished packaging—the total is 7 minutes.
Packaged at 7 minutes.
OK，发过去了，吃饭去。
OK, sent it off—time to eat.
First delivery done.
scenes.speak: To avoid copyright trouble, all fonts I use are commercially licensed. It's 7:50, I've finished packaging—the total is 7 minutes. OK, sent it off—time to eat.

scenes.title_cn: 次日：8点半PR说明早再反馈，单主说…
scenes.title_en: Next day: at 8:30 PM PR says they'll feedb…
sentences: 8点半了，PR说他那边明天早上再给我反馈，单主这边说没什么问题。
It's 8:30, PR will give feedback tomorrow morning—the client has no issues.
Overnight review.
早上好，现在是早上8点，PR那边给了修改方案，就是一些小问题。
Good morning, it's 8 AM—PR sent minor tweaks.
Morning revisions.
我估计上午就能给他交片。
I expect to deliver the final by lunchtime.
Delivery by noon.
scenes.speak: It's 8:30, PR will give feedback tomorrow morning—the client has no issues. Good morning, it's 8 AM—PR sent minor tweaks. I expect to deliver the final by lunchtime.

practice: A new unboxing ad came in for 800 yuan.
The footage splits into A-roll and two B-rolls.
The hero shade needs more time on screen.
pitfalls: Study the brand materials and match the client's style.
品牌方的补充信息都要消化，视频要贴合单主风格。
Give the hero shade more screen time.
主推色要加长，其他色分四屏展示。
规避版权，字体必须可商用。
shifts: 说接单只会说 get a job
用 talking-head ad（口播广告）、full-line review（全系列测评）、client（单主）
用 rough cut（粗剪）、fine cut（精剪）、packaging（包装）
用 hero shade（主推色）、4-panel layout（四屏展示）、review pass（审片）
